programs.title: College Football
programs.desc: The No. 17 Rebels (2-0, 1-0 SEC) host the Razorbacks (2-0, 0-0). The Rebels totaled 90 points in winning the last two meetings. Ole Miss won in its conference opener, 30-23 at Kentucky in Week 2 behind Kewan Lacy's 138 rushing yards and a touchdown.

programs.title: College Football
programs.desc: The Green Wave visit the No. 13 Rebels. Ole Miss is off to its fifth straight 3-0 start, while Tulane is undefeated this late into the season for the first time since 2022. Ole Miss leads the rivalry series 43-28, winning the past 13 games played.

programs.title: College Football
programs.desc: A clash at the top of the SEC pits the No. 13 Rebels (4-0, 2-0) against the No. 4 Tigers (4-0, 1-0). LSU claimed seven of the past nine meetings, but dropped its last two visits to Oxford, Miss., including a 55-49 Ole Miss win in a 2023 barn burner.

programs.title: College Football
programs.desc: The Cougars (3-2) face a stiff road test as they visit the Rebels (5-0) in Mississippi. Former Ferris State quarterback Trinidad Chambliss has thrown for 974 yards and four TDs for Ole Miss since replacing sophomore Austin Simmons as the starter.

programs.title: College Football
programs.desc: The No. 5 Rebels (6-0, 3-0 SEC) and No. 9 Bulldogs (5-1, 3-1) play a high-stakes game between the hedges. Ole Miss has won two of the last three meetings after a 28-10 victory in 2024, but Georgia won the last six get-togethers at Sanford Stadium.

programs.title: College Football
programs.desc: The No. 8 Rebels seek a bounce-back performance against the No. 13 Sooners. Ole Miss comes off a 43-35 setback to then-No. 9 Georgia on Oct. 18. Oklahoma put its Red River Rivalry loss in the rearview by beating South Carolina, 26-7 that same day.

programs.title: College Football
programs.desc: The No. 7 Rebels (7-1, 4-1 SEC) host the Gamecocks (3-5, 1-5). Ole Miss rebounded from its first loss of 2025 with a 34-26 road victory over then-No. 13 Oklahoma. The Rebels won the last two meetings by a combined 41 points, including 27-3 in 2024.

programs.title: College Football
programs.desc: The No. 7 Rebels (9-1, 5-1 SEC) try to solve the Gators (3-6, 2-4). Florida won the last three meetings to take a 13-12-1 series advantage. Kewan Lacy (MISS) shared the FBS lead with 16 touchdowns and was 10th with 912 rushing yards entering Week 12.

programs.title: Authentic ACC
programs.desc: In this edition of the series produced by NC State Athletics, get an inside look at Spring Football for the 2025 NC State Wolfpack.

programs.title: Unsportsmanlike with Evan, Canty and Michelle
programs.desc: Start the day off right with Chris Canty, Evan Cohen and Michelle Smallmon providing an energizing and informative way to take on the day. Sports, life and laughter are what it's all about.

programs.title: College Football
programs.desc: A tension-laden Egg Bowl sees Lane Kiffin's No. 7 Rebels (10-1, 6-1 SEC) visit the Bulldogs (5-6, 1-6). Kiffin is soon expected to decide on his future employment, with LSU and Florida reportedly in pursuit of the 50-year-old Ole Miss head coach.

programs.title: College Football
programs.desc: The No. 6 Fighting Irish face a tough test in the No. 10 Hurricanes. Miami won the last meeting, 41-8 in 2017. Notre Dame came up short against Ohio State 34-23 in the national title game last season. Miami was ranked as high as No. 4 in 2024.

programs.title: College Football
programs.desc: The Gators visit the No. 4 Hurricanes in a Florida Cup contest. In 2024, Miami won the first renewal of the three-way rivalry series in five years, beating Florida 41-17 in the process. Miami comes off a 49-12 beatdown of then-No. 18 South Florida.

programs.title: College Football
programs.desc: The No. 3 Hurricanes visit the No. 18 Seminoles. Miami leads the rivalry series 36-33 after beating Florida State 36-14 in 2024. FSU is coming off a double-overtime loss to Virginia on Sept. 26. Miami last played Sept. 20, beating Florida 26-7.

programs.title: College Football
programs.desc: The Cardinals (4-1, 1-1 ACC) try to bounce back against a tough foe in the No. 2 Hurricanes (5-0, 1-0). Louisville dropped its first game of the season in a 30-27 overtime decision versus Virginia on Oct. 4. Miami defeated Louisville 52-45 last year.

programs.title: College Football
programs.desc: The No. 9 Hurricanes (5-1, 1-1 ACC) try to bounce back against the Cardinal (3-4, 2-2). Miami was held to a season-low 63 rushing yards in its first loss of 2025, 24-21 to Louisville at home Oct. 17. This is the first meeting between these programs.

programs.title: Authentic ACC
programs.desc: In this edition of the series produced by Louisville Athletics, get an inside look at Spring Football for the 2025 Louisville Cardinals.
